AI hub, inbound wallboard tiles, new agent voices and transcription, dialler lead rules, short reference numbers, a Connections page and a simpler admin menu.

AI hub: one AI menu group holds AI agents, AI features, AI providers and connections, Voices and Transcription. Provider settings are split into tabs, with Untapped first.

Inbound wallboard tiles: new tiles show Inbound answered and Abandoned in queue, and the outbound tiles are relabelled to match. Oldest wait is split into calls and email/chat, each measured against its own service level.

Live transcription stream: a new Yaxxa AI setting lets live transcription use the GPU stream; left empty, nothing changes.

AI agents: an agent can use up to 500 knowledge tags, or choose Everything in the knowledge base. New agent voices from ElevenLabs, Cartesia and Azure (including South African voices) are available, and you can choose which provider voices a prompt.

Speechmatics transcription: calls can be transcribed with Speechmatics in batch, with optional real-time transcription. You can compare providers through the API.

Users: a Not signed in yet badge and filter show who has never logged in, and you can resend invitations to them in bulk.

Dialler lead rules: cap new leads per agent per day (predictive dialling included), set time windows per outcome, limit attempts per number over several days, set rest periods in calendar days, and set consecutive and total limits, with a preview of the effect. All of these are off by default.

Short reference numbers: tenants are numbered from 1001, customers and imports from 1000, and lead lists from 10000, so people can quote them easily.

Connections: a Connections page shows each connected service, its health, where it is used and how much, what else it could be used for, and a Make it better list of suggestions; Platform connections gives platform staff the same view across organisations.

A simpler admin menu: pages are grouped into tabs. Renames: Outcome, Break reason, Ticket, Chat flows, Sales targets. New pages: Callbacks, AI features and National registers. Nothing is removed and every old address still opens."}
